structure_review.rationale: Figure 1 puts both methoxyphenyl groups on the same central alkene carbon. The phenyl substituent on the TPPDC dicyanovinyl donor-side carbon is retained, rather than replacing it with the TPDC methyl group.
structure_review.limitations: Assistant visual source review and graph checks, not independent expert certification. SI corroboration remains incomplete.
